one_line: Rebel poet-soldier of Bengal whose songs and verses fused anti-colonial fire with radical anti-communal humanism.

appearance.age_look: Mid-20s, lean but sturdy build, suggesting both hardship and youthful energy.
appearance.face: Oval face with warm medium-brown complexion, slightly sharp nose, full expressive lips, high cheekbones, and large, intense anime-style eyes; default expression is calm but restless, a thoughtful gaze that can flash into defiant determination.
appearance.hair: Thick, straight, shoulder-length black hair parted slightly off-center, kept loose but neatly combed, with a simple off-white cotton Gandhi cap (side-folded Bengali style) resting on top, hair visible around the edges.
appearance.costume: A 1920s Bengal nationalist’s modest outfit: knee-length off-white khadi panjabi (long kurta) with a simple round collar and side slits, slightly loose at the sleeves; plain white dhoti wrapped in the Bengali style with a neat front pleat and draped to the ankles; a light, undyed khadi chador (shawl) with a very thin reddish-brown woven border casually folded over his left shoulder; simple brown leather sandals; a narrow black-thread amulet on his right wrist and a plain silver ring on his left hand, hinting at personal faith and relationships; fabrics look handwoven and slightly textured to evoke khadi and village looms.
appearance.signature: A worn, soft brown leather-bound notebook held in his left hand with a simple wooden fountain pen tucked into its strap, symbolizing his rebel poetry and journalism, occasionally tucked into his waistband when both hands are free.

ref_desc: Kazi Nazrul Islam is a mid-20s lean Bengali man with shoulder-length black hair under an off-white Gandhi cap, wearing an off-white khadi panjabi, white dhoti, light khadi chador and brown sandals, always carrying a brown leather-bound notebook with a wooden fountain pen, in a warm off-white and brown palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Kazi Nazrul Islam as a historically grounded 1920s Bengali rebel poet: a mid-20s lean man with an oval, warm medium-brown face, high cheekbones and large intense eyes, shoulder-length straight black hair parted slightly off-center and flowing loose beneath an off-white cotton Gandhi cap; his expression calm but restless, with a thoughtful gaze that can flash into defiant determination. Dress him in a modest, era-accurate outfit: a knee-length off-white khadi panjabi (long kurta) with a plain round collar and side slits, slightly loose sleeves, paired with a white dhoti wrapped in Bengali style, draped to the ankles with a neat front pleat. Drape a light undyed khadi chador with a very thin reddish-brown woven border over his left shoulder, and put simple brown leather sandals on his feet. Add small personal details: a narrow black-thread amulet on his right wrist and a plain silver ring on his left hand. His single signature prop is a worn soft brown leather-bound notebook held in his left hand with a simple wooden fountain pen tucked into its strap, sometimes shown tucked at his waistband when his hands are free. Use a warm, earthy palette dominated by off-white, warm beige, reddish-brown, brown leather and black hair; show him from multiple angles (front, side, back) but keep the same face, hair, clothing and notebook consistent in every view.
